title: Ad Insertion in LLM-Generated Responses
abstract: arXiv:2601.19435v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Sustainable monetization of large language models (LLMs) remains a critical open challenge. Traditional search advertising, which relies on static keywords, fails to capture the fleeting, context-dependent user intent---the specific information, goods, or services a user seeks---embedded in conversational flows. Beyond the standard goal of social welfare maximization effective LLM advertising requires contextual coherence (aligning ads semantically with transient user intent), computational efficiency (avoiding user-facing latency), and adherence to ethical and regulatory standards, including privacy preservation and explicit ad disclosure. Although recent solutions have explored bidding at the token and query levels, neither category holistically satisfies these constraints. translated_title: 大语言模型生成回复中的广告插入
translated_abstract: arXiv:2601.19435v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：大语言模型（LLMs）的可持续变现仍是一个关键开放挑战。传统搜索广告依赖于静态关键词，无法捕捉对话流中短暂且依赖上下文的用户意图——即用户寻求的特定信息、商品或服务。除了社会福利最大化的标准目标外，有效的LLM广告还需要上下文连贯性（将广告与瞬时用户意图语义对齐）、计算效率（避免面向用户的延迟），以及遵守道德和监管标准，包括隐私保护和明确的广告披露。尽管近期解决方案已探索了令牌级和查询级的竞价，但这两类方案均未全面满足这些约束。我们提出了一个框架，通过两种解耦策略解决这些矛盾。首先，我们将广告插入与响应生成解耦，以促进……
tldr: 本文提出一种通过解耦广告插入与响应生成的框架，在LLM生成回复中实现上下文连贯、高效且合规的广告变现。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a framework that decouples ad insertion from response generation to achieve contextually coherent, efficient, and compliant ad monetization in LLM-generated responses.
